$comment: Packages whose package.json names a license that is not a valid SPDX identifier, or none at all, while their license file is an approved license. Each entry names the exact version, the declared value (Unknown when package.json has none), the license of the license file and where it was checked. Entries for packages without a declared license pin the reviewed license file with licenseFileSha256, so a changed file needs a new review.

duck@0.1.12.reason: Dependency of mammoth (Word previews). The LICENSE file of this version is the BSD 2-Clause text.

khroma@2.1.0.reason: Dependency of mermaid, which Excalidraw uses to turn Mermaid diagrams into drawings. package.json has no license field; the file named license in this version is the MIT License text.
